title: Chinese President Xi Jinping speaks at Boao Forum for Asia
主要内容: Chinese President Xi Jinping addressed the Boao Forum for Asia, emphasizing China's commitment to opening up its economy. He announced plans to lower tariffs on automobiles and other products, as well as to enforce legal intellectual property protections for foreign firms. This announcement came on the same day the World Trade Organization reported that China filed a complaint against President Donald Trump's tariffs on imported steel and aluminum. Xi also highlighted China's intention to increase imports and achieve a more balanced international payments structure. He called for developed countries to stop imposing unfair trade restrictions on high-tech products and to relax export controls. In his speech, Xi promoted a vision of China as a global leader advocating for open systems and multilateral cooperation. He urged countries to reject zero-sum games and power politics, instead focusing on openness, connectivity, and mutual benefits. China's President Xi Jinping also mentioned the need to strengthen law enforcement related to intellectual property and encourage technological exchanges between Chinese and foreign enterprises. Regarding the Belt and Road Initiative, Xi downplayed any geopolitical ambitions, stating that the project aims to benefit the world rather than create exclusionary blocs. He reiterated that China has no geopolitical calculations and does not impose business deals on others.
